comments.headline: Demolition plan incomplete and inconsistently marked
comments.summary: Demolition plan (Sheet 8) lacks clear visual identification, dimensioning, and scope documentation for removed structures and improvements. Demolished structures not visually differentiated; demolished building dimensions and demolition methodology undocumented.
comments.crossDep: Building Services and Structures for demolition sequencing and methodology review

details.text: Existing structures lack overall length and width dimensions; only finished floor elevations provided for demolition items.

runComments.comment: Existing structures are not dimensioned on the demolition plan. While property boundary lines include bearings and distances, the actual structural footprints slated for demolition (concrete slab, sidewalks, retaining walls) do not have length/width dimensions provided. Only property line bearings and specific linear measurements of demolition items (e.g., '79 LF Concrete Retaining Wall') are shown.

The existing demolished structure (slab FFE 686.8') is shown on the demolition plan but is not dimensioned with overall length and width measurements. Only the finished floor elevation is provided; structural footprint dimensions are absent.

details.text: No legend for structural demolition items; tree legend provided but no symbol system for demolished structures and site improvements.

runComments.comment: No legend is provided on the demolition plan identifying all structures and improvements to be removed. While a 'Tree Legend' explains tree-related symbols (Trees to Remain, Heritage Trees, Protected Trees, etc.), there is no parallel demolition legend defining symbols or callout conventions for demolished structures and site improvements.

A Tree Legend is provided (Block 6, Sheet 8) distinguishing trees to remain, heritage trees, protected trees, and trees to be removed. However, no comprehensive legend is provided for structural demolition items (concrete, asphalt, utilities, etc.). Demolition items are identified by individual text callouts rather than a standardized symbol/legend system for structures and improvements to be removed.

details.text: Demolition scope not clearly stated; notes outline procedures but do not delineate site demolition work versus separate permits required.

runComments.comment: Scope of demolition work is not clearly stated on the plan. Site Demolition Notes (items 1-10) outline procedural requirements but do not explicitly delineate what is included in this site demolition plan versus what may require separate demolition permits (e.g., structural building demolition vs. site utilities/hardscape demolition).

Sheet 8 contains Site Demolition Notes (Block 5) providing procedural instructions for tree protection, utility abandonment, and general demolition activities. However, no clear scope statement distinguishes what demolition work is included in this site plan versus work covered by separate demolition permits or other related projects.

details.text: Complex structures (foundation slab, retaining wall, grease trap) lack detailed demolition methodology, sequencing, or removal procedures.

runComments.comment: Complex structures do not have detailed demolition callouts or notes specifying demolition methodology. While 'Demo Concrete Slab', 'Demo 79 LF Concrete Retaining Wall', and 'Abandon and Remove Grease Trap' are identified with callouts, there are no notes describing specific demolition methods, sequencing, or removal procedures for these complex items.

The existing structure (assisted living facility foundation slab) is shown for demolition but lacks detailed demolition callouts specifying demolition methodology. Site demolition notes reference hand-tool requirements for tree protection but do not address specific methodology for removal of the complex structure itself.

details.text: Demolished structures not visually differentiated with dashed outlines or hatching; identified only through direct text callouts.

runComments.comment: Structures proposed for demolition are not clearly indicated with consistent dashed lines or hatching. Demolition items are identified through direct text callouts in boxes (e.g., 'Demo Concrete Slab', 'Demo All Concrete Sidewalks') but the structural footprints themselves are not marked with distinct dashed outlines or hatching patterns to visually differentiate demolished areas from retained structures.

comments.headline: Building dimension and height documentation incomplete
comments.summary: Site plan lacks complete building dimension and height information needed to verify setbacks, height compliance, clearances, and fire access. Overall footprints, roof heights, and overhang projections are undocumented.
comments.crossDep: Fire Department for clearance verification and overhang coordination; Building Services to verify height calculation methodology
comments.attn: Detail 2.3 (vertical clearance) flagged in single run. Verify if clearance documentation is required or provided in separate fire protection engineering report.

details.text: Overall building dimensions (length × width) not provided; only perimeter wall segments dimensioned individually (e.g., 19.3', 10.2', 97.8').

runComments.comment: Overall building dimensions (length × width) are not shown on the site plan. Instead of overall length and width dimensions, detailed perimeter wall segments are dimensioned (e.g., individual wall segments of 19.3', 10.2', 97.8', etc.). Simple overall length × width dimensions for each building are not provided.

details.text: Building overhangs and roof heights not shown on site plan or ESC plan; may be contained in separate architectural plans not provided.

runComments.comment: Building overhangs and roof heights are not shown on the site plan or ESC plan to allow canopy conflict assessment. Detailed roof height and overhang information may be contained in architectural plans not provided in this site plan set. Site plan elevation notes list finished floor elevations but do not provide roof height or overhang projections.

Building heights are documented in the Building Height Table (Sheet 9, ranging 33'-4.75" to 36'-1"), and fire apparatus clearance (14 feet) is noted as a general requirement on Sheet 3. However, specific building overhang dimensions are not explicitly shown on the site plan to allow canopy conflict assessment.

details.text: Required vertical clearance (14 feet fire apparatus access) not documented; no overhead obstruction dimensions shown on fire plan.

runComments.comment: Required vertical clearance is not verified and documented on the site plan. No overhead obstructions (parking structures, canopies, overhead elements) are evident on this residential site requiring vertical clearance verification. Fire lanes are shown and dimensioned, but no overhead clearance requirements or dimensions are documented.

comments.headline: Site plan labeling and feature identification incomplete
comments.summary: Main site plan lacks comprehensive labeling of features (landscape species/sizes, building status, planting details) and does not cross-reference existing site conditions. Relationships between proposed and existing elements unclear on single document.
comments.attn: All four labeling findings flagged in run 1 only. Clarify whether issues were addressed in subsequent submissions or if later reviewers prioritized other concerns.

details.text: Landscape elements (trees, species, sizes) referenced to separate Sheet 32 but not identified on main site plan Sheet 9.

runComments.comment: All landscape elements are not labeled with required details on the main site plan. While trees are shown with symbols and reference numbers, specific landscape species and sizes are not labeled on Sheet 9. Trees are referenced to Sheet 32 for detailed list but not identified on the site plan itself.

details.text: Buildings labeled 'Bldg. 1' through 'Bldg. 8' with square footages but not explicitly marked 'proposed'; term used only in table descriptions.

runComments.comment: All structures are not clearly labeled as either existing or proposed on the main site plan. Buildings are labeled as 'Bldg. 1' through 'Bldg. 8' with square footages but are not explicitly marked as 'proposed.' The word 'proposed' appears only in table descriptions (Site Data Table) but not on the building labels themselves.

details.text: Landscape features (planting species, sizes, planter dimensions) not fully labeled on site plan; hard surfaces labeled only by text callouts.

runComments.comment: Features are not comprehensively labeled with all relevant dimensions and labels on the site plan. While hard surfaces are labeled with text callouts and buildings show wall segment dimensions, landscape elements (species, sizes, planter dimensions) are not fully labeled with required details on the main site plan.

details.text: Existing conditions (Sheet 4) and proposed improvements (Sheet 9) not cross-referenced; field relationships between existing features and new paths undocumented.

runComments.comment: The relationship between existing site conditions (existing structures, stairs, egress from demolished building) and proposed paths cannot be verified on a single sheet. Existing conditions are shown on Sheet 4, proposed site plan on Sheet 9, and they are not cross-referenced. Field conditions relating existing site features to new pedestrian paths are not documented on the site plan.

comments.headline: Hard surface and landscape feature identification insufficient
comments.summary: Site and landscape plans lack comprehensive legends and dimension documentation for hard surfaces and planting features. Hard surface types not distinguished from buildings/vegetation; planter dimensions missing.
comments.attn: Planter dimension finding (7.24) flagged in run 3 only. Verify whether planter sizing is acceptable to landscape/stormwater review or requires clarification.

details.text: Hard surface types not shown in comprehensive legend per FPCM § 1.1.0(C); identified only through direct text callouts (e.g., 'Concrete Sidewalk') without hatch patterns or distinct symbols.

runComments.comment: Hard surface types are not shown in a comprehensive legend that distinguishes parking/circulation surfaces from buildings and vegetation areas. Hard surfaces are identified only through direct text callouts on the plan (e.g., 'Concrete Sidewalk', 'Decomposed Granite Walkway', 'Concrete Drive') without a coordinated legend using hatch patterns or distinct symbols.

Landscape plan shows proposed paving (H.1) and other landscape features (H.2-H.7) but does not clearly establish a legend that explicitly distinguishes parking/circulation surfaces from buildings and vegetation areas per FPCM requirements. While hatch patterns differentiate zones, the legend does not clearly isolate hard surface types for parking versus other hard surfaces.

details.text: Landscape plan shows planting zones but does not provide specific dimensions (size and height) for individual proposed planters.

runComments.comment: Landscape plan shows planting zones and identifies areas for parking lot landscaping (H.4) and street yard plantings (H.2, H.3) but does not provide specific dimensions (size and height) for individual proposed planters.

comments.headline: Project scope and cover sheet documentation incomplete
comments.summary: Cover sheet and general notes lack clear scope statement distinguishing site plan improvements from separate permits or related projects. Building Information Table and Construction Plan status undefined.
comments.crossDep: Building Services to clarify whether Construction Plan (vertical construction) is required as part of site plan or submitted separately with building permits
comments.attn: Building Information Table (7.8) flagged in run 1 only. Verify whether table is required or if project data documented acceptably elsewhere on plan.

details.text: Improvements scope versus separate permits not clearly identified; no explicit statement delineating site plan work from separate demolition or construction permits.

runComments.comment: Plans do not clearly identify which improvements are proposed with this site plan versus improvements proposed under separate permits or related projects. While references exist to demolition permits, erosion control measures, and future certificate of occupancy requirements, there is no explicit statement clarifying the scope of work included in this specific site plan submission versus separate construction plans or phased work.

General release notes (Sheet 3, Block 12) state 'All improvements shall be made in accordance with the released site plan' and reference demolition permits separately. However, no comprehensive statement clearly identifies which specific improvements are included in this site plan versus improvements proposed under separate permits, construction plans, or related projects.

details.text: No consolidated scope of work statement on cover sheet; project scope (39 units, 8 buildings) embedded in scattered references throughout plan.

runComments.comment: Scope of work statement is not provided on the cover sheet or main site plan detailing proposed site work. While scattered references exist to site improvements (biofiltration pond, buildings, utilities), there is no consolidated narrative scope statement describing the overall proposed development, demolition, and infrastructure improvements.

Project scope (39 townhome units, 8 buildings) is embedded in the cover sheet data and site plan details but no dedicated 'Scope of Work' statement block clearly details the proposed site work, improvements, and construction activities in a comprehensive narrative format.

details.text: Vertical construction (8 multi-family buildings) shown on site plan but Construction Plan presence unverified; no dedicated plan sheets identified in 39-sheet package.

runComments.comment: Construction Plan (C Plan) presence cannot be verified from the site plan set. Vertical construction is proposed (8 multi-family buildings), but no cross-reference or notation on the site plan indicates whether a separate C Plan has been submitted. This determination requires review of the complete permit application.

The project includes eight multi-family residential buildings (vertical construction) shown on the site plan. No dedicated Construction Plan (C Plan) sheet providing detailed vertical construction information appears in the 39-sheet site plan package. Sheets 22-28 are labeled 'Construction Details' but address utility infrastructure details, not vertical/building construction. It is unclear whether a C Plan must be part of the site plan submittal or is submitted separately with building permit applications.

details.text: Building Information Table not included on cover sheet; limited Austin Fire Department requirements table present but no unit count, GFA, or parking data table.

runComments.comment: No Building Information Table is included on the cover sheet. While a limited Austin Fire Department requirements table is shown, there is no comprehensive Building Information Table listing unit counts, gross floor area, parking requirements and provisions, and other project building data.

comments.headline: Topography contour intervals do not meet requirements
comments.summary: Topography shown at 1-foot intervals on-site instead of required 2-foot intervals per Environmental Review Requirements Section 3. Off-site contours inadequate in interval spacing and areal extent.
comments.attn: Finding flagged in run 1 only; not re-verified by subsequent reviews. Confirm whether issue was corrected in resubmitted plans or accepted under relaxed standards.

details.text: All topography sheets (existing conditions, grading, ESC plan) show 1-foot on-site and 1-foot off-site intervals; required standard is 2-foot on-site and 50-foot off-site.

runComments.comment: Topography is not shown at the required 2-foot contour intervals on-site. Instead, all sheets (existing conditions, grading plan, and ESC plan) show 1-foot contour intervals on-site and 1-foot intervals off-site. The required standard per Environmental Review Requirements Section 3 is 2-foot on-site and 50-foot off-site intervals. Off-site contours do not consistently extend a full 100 feet in all directions.
